title: Spinning Up in Deep RL
summary: We’re releasing Spinning Up in Deep RL, an educational resource designed to let anyone learn to become a skilled practitioner in deep reinforcement learning. Spinning Up consists of crystal-clear examples of RL code, educational exercises, documentation, and tutorials.
body: We’re releasing Spinning Up in Deep RL, an educational resource designed to let anyone learn to become a skilled practitioner in deep reinforcement learning. Spinning Up consists of crystal-clear examples of RL code, educational exercises, documentation, and tutorials.
summaryZh: OpenAI 推出了名为“Spinning Up in Deep RL”的教育资源，旨在帮助开发者和学习者成为深度强化学习领域的熟练从业者，包含代码、练习和文档教程。

aiReview.reasonZh: 这是一份关于深度强化学习的入门教育资源发布，属于教程性质，对大模型技术本身影响较小。
